definitions.explanation: The Emperor of Japan and his family. Refers to the institution and the family collectively.

examples.japanese: {皇室|こうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An imperial household ceremony was held.

examples.japanese: {皇室|こうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公務|こうむ}→公務：00245_koumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなされている→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: Members of the imperial family carry out many official duties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皇室|こうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{王室|おうしつ}→王室：15297_oushitsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese imperial household is said to be the oldest royal family in the world.

notes:
{皇室|こうしつ} refers to the Japanese imperial family as an institution.

FORMS:
{皇|こう} (emperor) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (house, chamber)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇室|こうしつ}{典範|てんぱん}: Imperial House Law
- {皇室|こうしつ}⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧: imperial household events
- {皇室|こうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧: members of the imperial family

- ⟦{王室|おうしつ}→王室：15297_oushitsu⟧: royal family (for non-Japanese monarchies)
